title: Royal Couscous with Cauliflower and Spices
description: A flavorful and healthy couscous dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner, that combines the warmth of Moroccan spices with the earthiness of cauliflower.

ingredients.name: Royal Spices
ingredients.notes: available at most spice shops or online

ingredients.name: Moroccan Spices
ingredients.notes: available at most spice shops or online

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Moroccan spices and royal spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is tender but still crisp, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the couscous and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and season with salt and parsley.
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
